Alias: Order ID, Order #, Reference ID, order_id
Description: Unique order identifier, e.g. "200012623519520". Source: tracking iframe order_id parameter.
One entry per purchased line item (4 items in the fixture). Source: image alt names + iframe item_prices/item_quantities.

Alias: Shipping Cost, Shipping Fee, Delivery Fee
Description: Shipping charge as a string; "0" when free.
Sum of all line totals, 2-decimal money, e.g. "36.05". Source: iframe subtotal parameter.

Alias: Order Total, Total, Total Charged, cart_total
Description: Total charged incl. tax/shipping, 2-decimal money, e.g. "39.25". Source: iframe cart_total parameter.

Alias: Sales Tax, Tax Amount, Estimated Tax
Description: Tax amount, 2-decimal money; "0" when zero, e.g. "3.20". Derived: Grand Total - Subtotal - Shipping.

Alias: Payment Method, Card Type, Tender Type
Description: Card network name from the wallet logo alt, e.g. "Visa".
Human-readable product title, e.g. "Colgate Max Fresh Knockout Whitening Toothpaste, Mint Fusion, 6.3 oz, 3 Pack".
Number of units as a string, e.g. "1".

Alias: Item Total, Extended Price, Line Subtotal
